name: BITEZ XL - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 4000MG Gummies - Blue Hawaii
description:
*DOUBLE THE STRENGTH OF OUR REGULAR BITEZ GUMMIES!

Escape to the tropics with Blue Hawaii XL BITEZ Gummies. Each double-stacked gummy layers sweet tart blue razz with juicy pineapple and a splash of creamy coconut, capturing the essence of a refreshing Blue Hawaiian mocktail in every bite. These vacation-worthy flavors pair perfectly with our most powerful XL formula yet. Infused with a powerful Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend, each gummy delivers 2,000mg per piece (2 gummies per bag, 4,000mg total).
